title: Dimension-filtered module flatness on all etale charts
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], $Y,B$ schemes over $S$, $f:X\to h_Y$, and $g:B\to Y$, where $h_Y,h_B$ are the represented algebraic spaces [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Let $M$ be a module on the small etale site of $X$, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Form the actual sheaf fibre product $X_B=X\times_{h_Y}h_B$ with first projection $q$ [def-sfb-space-sheaf-fibre-product] and put $M_B=q^*M$, using tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Define $P_n(X,M;B)$ by the following condition: for every object $a:U\to X_B$ of its small etale site, and every $u\in U$ mapping to $v\in B$, if $\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(v)}\kappa(u)\ge n$, then $(a^*_{\mathrm{Zar}}M_B)_u$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{B,v}$. Here $a^*_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ is restriction to Zariski opens [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction], stalks are [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], residue fields and their maps are [def-weil-residue-field], transcendence degree is [def-kun-transcendence-degree], and base flatness is [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], with scalar restriction along the actual stalk map of $U\to B$. The map $U\to B$ is the Yoneda preimage of its composite with the second sheaf-pullback projection. This defines the predicate for arbitrary module sheaves and maps; it is used for finite-type quasi-coherent modules on locally finite-type families.
